section.para: The ngx_http_json_module module (1.31.5) creates variables whose values are extracted from a JSON document held in another variable.
A document is parsed only once per request, no matter how many variables are extracted from it. Parsing is performed on the first access to any of these variables.
This module is not built by default, it should be enabled with the --with-http_json_module configuration parameter.

directive.name: json_max_depth
directive.para: Limits the nesting depth of a parsed JSON document. A document nested deeper is considered invalid.

directive.name: json_set
directive.para: Creates a variable whose value is extracted from the JSON document held in the source variable at the given path.

The value of a JSON string is stored with escape sequences decoded. The values of numbers, booleans, and null are stored as they appear in the document. If the path addresses an object or an array, its whole text is stored, including the enclosing braces or brackets.

If the addressed member or element is absent, the variable is not found. If the source variable is empty or not found, or if its value is not a valid JSON document, all variables extracted from this source are not found.
The same variable cannot be created twice.
